title: A son blamed for a family’s decline
odia:
କୁଳ କ୍ଷୟ ବେଳକୁ
ଘୋଡ଼ାମୁହାଁ ପୁଅ ଜନ୍ମ।
literal_meaning: When the family is nearing ruin, a horse-faced son is born.
meaning_odia: ପରିବାରର ଅବନତି ସହ ଜଣେ ପୁଅକୁ ଅଯୋଗ୍ୟ ବୋଲି ଦୋଷ ଦେବାର କଠୋର କଥା। ଉତ୍ସର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ ଏହା ଅଯୋଗ୍ୟ ପୁତ୍ରକୁ ବୁଝାଏ; ଘୋଡ଼ାମୁହାଁ ହେଉଛି ଉକ୍ତିର ଅପମାନଜନକ ଛବି, ଚେହେରା ଦେଖି ଯୋଗ୍ୟତା ବିଚାର କରିବାର ଆଧାର ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The saying places the birth of a disparaged son beside the family’s decline. The inspected source gloss identifies the target as an unfit son. Its harsh image expresses blame and pessimism about the family’s future; physical appearance does not establish a person’s character or ability.
usage_example: In a fictional family dispute, an elder quotes the saying while blaming an adult son’s reckless decisions for losses. The quotation reveals the elder’s harsh judgement. This illustration is newly composed.
cultural_context: The image joins continuity through a son with anxiety about the family line ending. The animal comparison intensifies the insult, while the timing makes the birth sound like a sign of impending ruin. These are features of the saying’s rhetoric.
